label: HELD_OUT_EVALUATION
evaluation_rule: As the development casebook: a span counts only after it is resolved through the verified document set by the handle it carries, its declared issuer, document type and revision agree with that set, and its excerpt is found inside the source bytes at the range it declares. Controls are reported apart and must not be credited; the missing-source control has no range by construction; wrong-issuer and wrong-date probes are structural checks (attribution integrity and cutoff) reported by the driver.

provenance.authored_after: the v2 selection mechanism (per-issuer top-k, exact-preview grouping) was implemented from ER3 and development evidence; before any evaluation of v2 on these cases; no tuning followed

family_overlap.IRM: issuer untouched by the development casebook (no IRM case there); its 10-Q is a new document
family_overlap.MOS: development case MOS-IMPAIRMENT is in the MOS 10-K; the 8-K and 10-K/A here are other documents of the same issuer (issuer overlap, not document overlap)
family_overlap.ISRG: development case ISRG-LITIGATION is in the ISRG 10-K/10-Q; the 8-K here is another document (issuer overlap)
family_overlap.DG: development case DG-LITIGATION is in the DG 10-K/10-Q; the 8-K here is another document (issuer overlap)
family_overlap.time: every document is accepted before the 2026-08-12 18:00 UTC cutoff; the MOS 8-K (2026-08-10) is the newest
